mapper.select: SELECT mi.name AS name, mi.longitude AS lng, mi.latitude AS lat, COUNT(d.id) AS count FROM doctor d JOIN medical_institution mi ON mi.id = d.institution_id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND mi.deleted = 0 GROUP BY mi.id, mi.name, mi.longitude, mi.latitude
SELECT title AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM doctor WHERE deleted = 0 AND title IS NOT NULL AND title <> '' GROUP BY title ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT dt.name AS name, COUNT(d.id) AS value FROM doctor d JOIN department dt ON dt.id = d.department_id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND dt.deleted = 0 GROUP BY dt.name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT YEARWEEK(sale_time, 1) AS week, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS outboundQty FROM sales_record WHERE sale_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{weeks} WEEK) GROUP BY YEARWEEK(sale_time, 1) ORDER BY week

SELECT dr.name AS drugName, dr.specification AS spec, co.name AS companyName, loc.name AS locationName, ds.stock_qty AS stockQty, ds.threshold AS threshold FROM drug_stock ds JOIN drug dr ON dr.id = ds.drug_id JOIN sales_location loc ON loc.id = ds.location_id LEFT JOIN pharma_company co ON co.id = ds.company_id WHERE ds.deleted = 0 AND ds.stock_qty <= ds.threshold ORDER BY ds.stock_qty ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT t.time, t.event, t.delta, t.type FROM ( SELECT s.sale_time AS time, CONCAT_WS(' · ', co.name, loc.name, CONCAT(dr.name, ' 出库')) AS event, -s.qty AS delta, 'out' AS type FROM sales_record s JOIN sales_location loc ON loc.id = s.location_id JOIN drug dr ON dr.id = s.drug_id LEFT JOIN pharma_company co ON co.id = s.company_id UNION ALL SELECT r.in_time AS time, CONCAT_WS(' · ', co.name, loc.name, CONCAT(dr.name, ' 入库')) AS event, r.qty AS delta, 'in' AS type FROM replenishment_order r JOIN sales_location loc ON loc.id = r.location_id JOIN drug dr ON dr.id = r.drug_id LEFT JOIN pharma_company co ON co.id = r.company_id ) t ORDER BY t.time DESC LIMIT #{n}

SELECT ol.id AS id, ol.module AS module, ol.operation AS operation, COALESCE(u.real_name, ol.username) AS actor, ol.operation_time AS time FROM operation_log ol LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = ol.user_id WHERE ol.module <> '认证' ORDER BY ol.operation_time DESC LIMIT #{n}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'in' THEN t.qty END), 0) AS inQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'out' THEN t.qty END), 0) AS outQty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM sales_record WHERE sale_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND sale_time < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) + INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS salesAmount FROM ( SELECT qty, 'in' AS type FROM replenishment_order WHERE in_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND in_time < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) + INTERVAL 7 DAY UNION ALL SELECT qty, 'out' AS type FROM sales_record WHERE sale_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND sale_time < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) + INTERVAL 7 DAY ) t

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drug WHERE deleted = 0) AS drugCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_location WHERE deleted = 0) AS locationCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_institution WHERE deleted = 0) AS institutionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doctor WHERE deleted = 0) AS doctorCount
SELECT name, longitude AS lng, latitude AS lat FROM sales_location WHERE deleted = 0 AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND latitude IS NOT NULL

SELECT mi.name AS name, mi.longitude AS lng, mi.latitude AS lat, COUNT(d.id) AS count FROM medical_institution mi LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.institution_id = mi.id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE mi.deleted = 0 AND mi.longitude IS NOT NULL AND mi.latitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mi.id, mi.name, mi.longitude, mi.latitude
